title: Parmigiana di Patate
subtitle: Baked layers of potato, tomato, and mozzarella
excerpt: Thinly sliced potatoes layered with tomato passata, mozzarella, and parmesan, then baked until tender and golden. A southern Italian vegetarian bake that feeds a crowd.
sourceNotes: Campanian and Pugliese variation of the parmigiana theme using potato instead of aubergine; a common southern Italian home-cooking staple.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze the baked dish in portions. Reheat from frozen at 180C covered for 20 minutes, then uncovered for 10 minutes.
recipe.batchNotes: This recipe doubles well in a larger baking tin.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble a day ahead, refrigerate, and bake from cold adding 10 minutes to the cook time.

content.text: This is the potato version of the classic southern Italian parmigiana. Slice the potatoes as thin as you can so they cook through in the oven. A mandoline makes quick work of it.
Heat the oven to 190C. Stir the garlic into the passata. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread a thin layer of seasoned passata across the base of a deep baking dish.
Lay a single overlapping layer of potato slices on top. Season lightly with salt. Drizzle with a little olive oil.
Spread a layer of passata over the potato. Add a layer of mozzarella slices and a few basil leaves if using. Scatter some parmesan over.
Repeat the layers, finishing with a layer of potato, the last of the passata, and a final scatter of parmesan.
Drizzle the top with olive oil. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 40 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for a further 15 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

items.symptom: The potato is still firm after the full cook time.
items.cause: The slices were too thick, or the oven temperature was too low.
items.fix: Cover again with foil and bake for a further 15 minutes. Check for doneness with a knife tip.

items.symptom: The top is very brown but the middle is watery.
items.cause: The passata had too much liquid and the layers were not pressed down firmly.
items.fix: Cover with foil to stop the top burning further and continue baking until the liquid reduces. Let it rest fully before serving.

items.cause: The layers were not seasoned individually.
items.fix: Season each potato layer as you build. The passata and cheese carry most of the flavour, so every layer needs a pinch of salt.
